name: scores the two source-board regions independently
input: the first two rows of the reported G/W/S board

name: does not join diagonal cells and keeps zero-crown terrain cells
input: diagonal equal letters and two zero-crown singletons

name: scores every region in the full reported board
handles the reported edge cases and empty boards
input: single-cell, one-region, zero-crown, and empty boards
test:
assert board_score([['G0']]) == 0
assert board_score([['G1', 'G2', 'G3']]) == 18
assert board_score([['G1', 'W2'], ['W3', 'G4']]) == 10
assert board_score([['G0', 'G0', 'G0'], ['G0', 'G0', 'G0'], ['G0', 'G0', 'G0']]) == 0
assert board_score([]) == 0
assert board_score([[]]) == 0
